integrity: Exact Weyl torus integration and calculus prove the stated inequality; the included checker is corroboration, not a substitute for universal proof. No independent scientific audit has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary, unnormalized fundamental and adjoint trace characters on SU(3); the earlier source already computes the pure-adjoint sixth moment 145. The three-character band and SU(N) with N variable are not covered. Priority beyond inspected literature is not independently established.
title: Sharp sixth moments and nonlocal optimal stability for the fundamental–adjoint character pair of \(SU(3)\)
